item.title: Bulletin updated at 17:50 HKT 29/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southwesterly airstream will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, under the influence of the subtropical ridge, the weather will still be very hot over southeastern China. With the subtropical ridge strengthening again, it will be mainly fine and persistently very hot over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Date/Month: 30/06 (Sunday)
Wind: Southwest force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. More showers with isolated squally thunderstorms at first. Hot with sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
